players.product: physics-plus-AI molecular discovery platform and Bunsen co-scientist

quarterly_data.signal: Predictive Tox validation in use: CTO of Software Pat Lorton said he thinks a customer is planning to present that it had a program that failed because of a tox liability; it tested every computational model available and none gave any signal, then Predictive Tox 'told them exactly what was wrong with the molecule, and they could design around it' - 'the first time they've ever been able to design around a liability like this' (company account). President of R&D Karen Akinsanya said Schrödinger's structure-based Predictive Tox model moves toxicology de-risking earlier in the workflow and is being used in all of its collaborations and internal programs.
